theorem_statement: Theorem 1 (Voronoi Facet Step Jump Discontinuity): lim_{eps -> 0+} ||phi(x0 + eps n) - phi(x0 - eps n)||_2 = ||g_i - g_j||_2 = sqrt(2 - 2<g_i, g_j>) > 0

geometric_proof_steps.description: Unit hypersphere gallery prototypes g_i in S^(D-1)
Voronoi cell partitioning V_i = {z | <z, g_i> > <z, g_j>}
Facet boundary F_ij = closure(V_i) cap closure(V_j)
Normal vector n = (g_i - g_j)/||g_i - g_j|| perpendicular to F_ij
One-sided limit jump norm ||g_i - g_j||_2 > 0 for distinct enrolled identities
